servtuner check-target's output: one entry per check, in order. A check that depends on a failed one is skipped. status is failed when any check failed, warning when any warned, else ok. Never carries a secret value.

Schema file: `schema/json/check-target-result.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `ea52778da279`.

## Definitions

### checkStatus

The verdict of the whole check.

Type: `"ok"`, `"warning"`, `"failed"`

### checkStepStatus

skipped: not run, because a check it depends on failed or it does not apply (no Prometheus, no workload, generate not asked for).

Type: `"ok"`, `"warning"`, `"failed"`, `"skipped"`

### checkName

Type: `"resolve"`, `"connect"`, `"tls"`, `"auth"`, `"model"`, `"generate"`, `"metrics"`, `"gpu_metrics"`, `"workload"`
